newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-GERMANY'S EURO HEROES CRASH DOWN TO EARTH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-GERMANY'S EURO HEROES CRASH DOWN TO EARTH.

text.p: Karlsruhe and Hamburg came down to earth with a bump in the Bundesliga on Saturday after outstanding UEFA Cup performances in midweek.
Karlsruhe, who produced a breathtaking display to defeat Roma 3-0 on Tuesday, went down 3-1 at home to Werder Bremen.
Hamburg, who scored a 3-0 over win Spartak Moscow, were soundly beaten 2-0 by struggling Schalke.
Bremen's win moved them up to fourth place, level on points with Borussia Dortmund and Cologne, who notched up a comfortable 4-1 away win over Armenia Bielefeld.
Champions Dortmund and third-placed Bayern Munich play in the weekend's outstanding match on Sunday.
Leaders VfB Stuttgart drew 0-0 with second-placed Bayer Leverkusen on Friday.
